units.source_text: 柏木大纳言盛年夭逝，悲伤悼惜之人甚多。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Grand Counselor, died young in the prime of his life, and many people grieved for him and lamented his loss.

units.source_text: 源氏向来闻人死耗，即使是泛泛之交，只要其人是略有世誉的，无不悼惜，

en.t: Genji had always mourned when he heard of someone's death; even if the acquaintance was slight, so long as the person had some reputation in the world, he could not help grieving,

units.source_text: 何况这柏木乃常来之客，朝夕相亲，自比别人知己。

en.t: and all the more so with Kashiwagi, who had been a frequent visitor, close to him morning and evening, and whom he had regarded as more intimate than others.

units.source_text: 如今死去，使他觉得甚不可解，且可恋之事甚多，故往往触景生情，想念不已。

en.t: Now that Kashiwagi was dead, Genji found it deeply hard to understand, and since there was so much about him to long for, every occasion stirred his feelings and left him unable to stop thinking of him.

units.source_text: 柏木周年忌辰，源氏替他大做功德。

en.t: On the anniversary of Kashiwagi's death, Genji held grand memorial rites to accumulate merit on his behalf.

units.source_text: 他看看无知无识地嬉笑玩耍的薰君的模样，觉得毕竟十分可怜，心中便生一念，替薰君另舍黄金百两，布施僧道。

en.t: Seeing young Kaoru laughing and playing in innocent ignorance, Genji felt that the child was, after all, truly pitiable; moved by this thought, he separately donated one hundred taels of gold for Kaoru's sake as alms to the monks.

units.source_text: 柏木的父大臣不知内情，但觉不胜感谢喜慰。

en.t: Kashiwagi's father, the minister, knew nothing of the truth behind it, but felt only overwhelming gratitude, joy, and comfort.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将也替柏木做许多功德，亲自郑重办理一切法事。

en.t: General Yugiri also performed many acts of merit for Kashiwagi, personally and solemnly overseeing all the memorial services.

units.source_text: 又在此周年忌辰赴一条院殷勤慰问。

en.t: On this same anniversary of the death, he also went to Ichijo-in and offered attentive words of consolation.

units.source_text: 父大臣和母夫人想不到夕雾对柏木的感情比诸弟更深，都非常感激。

en.t: Kashiwagi's father, the minister, and his mother had not expected Yugiri's feeling for Kashiwagi to be deeper than that of his own younger brothers, and they were both deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 他们看见柏木死后世人对他如此尊重，越发觉得可惜，悼念之情永无尽期。

en.t: Seeing that people still honored Kashiwagi so greatly after his death, they felt his loss all the more keenly, and their mourning seemed to have no end.
